traditional: Vitality and authority combined with love, money, and pleasure.

modern.blend: Identity blended with charm, pleasure, and a sense of value. Sociability and taste become part of how you show up. Only the conjunction is possible, as Venus stays close to the Sun.
modern.harmonious: Adds likability, aesthetic sense, and ease with people.
modern.hard: Can tip toward vanity, indulgence, or coasting on charm.
modern.business: Tends to be well-liked in the work and to 'look good' doing it.

cyclicNote: This pair runs a full conjunction-to-conjunction cycle; waxing/waning phase meaning is carried on the transit entries.

provenance.cyclic: applied per-aspect on transit entries (cyclic model)
